summary.content:
Today's selection covers 108 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 64 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Judge Stays Pentagon’s Labeling of Anthropic as ‘Supply Chain Risk’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Inside a Modern Fraud Attack: From Bot Signups to Account Takeovers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
